subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Analysing the Etihad Rail essay and collecting information
outcomes: Analyse the structure of an informative essay about a rail safety campaign
Identify topic sentences and supporting sentences
Collect facts about a type of transport for an essay

tf.s: The vital message of the Etihad Rail campaign was to put safety first.
tf.why: Yes, people must respect the railway at all times.

tf.s: The Safety Bus was a roadshow that travelled around Western Abu Dhabi.
tf.why: Correct, it gave people information about the railway.

tf.s: People are told to cross the railway track wherever they like.
tf.why: They should use bridges and underpasses.

tf.s: Underpasses were also built so animals like camels and gazelles can cross.
Flyers were given out to alert communities about railway safety.
tf.why: Yes, flyers spread the safety message.

tf.s: The Etihad Rail essay has three paragraphs.
A supporting sentence gives details about the topic sentence.
tf.why: Correct, it supports the main idea with facts.

tf.s: An informative essay mainly tells a funny story.
tf.why: An informative essay gives facts and information.

tf.s: Questions like 'When was it invented?' help you collect information for an essay.
tf.why: Yes, question prompts guide your research.

tf.s: A roadshow is a show that stays in one place.
tf.why: A roadshow travels from place to place.

boxes.q: What was the campaign's main message?
boxes.why: Safety first was the vital message.
It travelled around to share safety information.

boxes.q: How can people cross the railway safely?
boxes.why: Bridges and underpasses keep people off the track.

boxes.q: Which animals can use the underpasses?
boxes.why: The essay mentions camels, gazelles and reptiles.
Flyers warned people about railway safety.

boxes.q: How many paragraphs does the essay have?
What type of essay is the Etihad Rail text?
What does a topic sentence do?
boxes.why: It tells you what the paragraph is about.

o: a path that goes under something
boxes.why: An underpass goes under the railway.

boxes.q: Where did the Safety Bus travel?
boxes.why: The roadshow toured Western Abu Dhabi.

hunt.q: Paths that go under the track
Papers given out to alert people

o: a planned set of activities to make people safer
mcq.why: A campaign is an organised effort with one aim.

mcq.q: Which three things were part of the campaign?
o: the Safety Bus roadshow, safety rules and flyers
a film, a song and a game
a race, a party and prizes
mcq.why: These are the main parts described in the essay.

mcq.q: Which animals does the essay mention using the crossings?
mcq.why: The essay names camels, gazelles and reptiles.

mcq.q: What do you call the sentences that give details about the main idea?
mcq.why: Supporting sentences add facts and examples.

mcq.q: You want to cross the railway track. What should you do?
o: use a bridge or an underpass
mcq.why: The campaign says to use bridges and underpasses.

mcq.q: You are writing about the bicycle. Which question helps you collect information?
mcq.why: Prompts like this guide your research.

mcq.q: Which is the best topic sentence for a paragraph about trains' benefits?
mcq.why: It clearly states the paragraph's main idea.

mcq.q: Why were underpasses built for animals as well as people?
o: so animals can cross the railway safely
mcq.why: Protecting animals is part of railway safety.

mcq.q: Why did the campaign use a travelling bus rather than one office?
o: to reach communities in many places
because buses are faster than trains
mcq.why: A roadshow takes the message to people where they live.

mcq.q: Why is it useful to analyse the structure of a model essay before writing?
o: you can copy its organisation in your own essay
so you can copy its sentences exactly
mcq.why: Seeing how paragraphs are organised helps you plan.
